newsitem.title: USA: El Paso N.M. gas maintenance continues.
newsitem.headline: El Paso N.M. gas maintenance continues.

text.p: El Paso Natural Gas, as part of an extensive maintenance schedule, said Tuesday it will keep its Chaco gas processing plant in New Mexico down until Thursday, taking about 300-500 million cubic feet per day off the market.
The pipeline is also conducting maintenance at several downstream locations, a company spokesman said.
At the Belen station in New Mexico, production will be cut by about 70 mmcfd from Wednesday and lasting through Sunday, he said.
El Paso also shut its Roswell, N.M., station today for one-day maintenance, affecting about 150 mmcfd of supply.
